title: Lead Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 Simplify Group (The Most Group Inc.) is a high\-growth healthcare technology organisation operating three entities: Simplify Healthcare — a leading healthcare payer SaaS platform serving large US health plans; SimplifyX™ — an AI\-powered clinical automation and innovation product; and Simplify Alpha — a clinical intelligence and analytics platform. Major clients include UHG/Optum, Kaiser Permanente, BCBSNC, and HMSA. The Group runs entirely on Microsoft Azure with SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, ISO 27001, and HIPAA certifications. In 2026 the Group is building a centralised Group Platform Engineering team — consolidating entity\-siloed infrastructure ownership into a unified, expert cloud platform function.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 The Lead Cloud Platform Engineer is a senior individual contributor who serves as the primary cloud platform owner for an assigned entity (Simplify Healthcare, SimplifyX™, or Simplify Alpha). Reporting to the Manager — Platform Engineering IT, the role owns cloud infrastructure design, CI/CD pipelines, reliability engineering, cost governance, and security posture for their assigned environment. The role requires both deep technical execution and the ability to lead within a team — setting standards, mentoring junior engineers, and acting as the platform partner to development and product teams. The Lead Cloud Platform Engineer reduces delivery friction, removes back\-and\-forth between dev and infrastructure, and builds platforms that development teams are proud to deploy on.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Cloud infrastructure design
* CI/CD pipelines
* Reliability engineering
* Cost governance
* Security posture management
* Mentoring junior engineers
* Acting as the platform partner to development and product teams



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering.
* Azure certifications required: AZ\-104 (Azure Administrator Associate) as a minimum; AZ\-305 (Solutions Architect Expert) strongly preferred.
* Kubernetes certification preferred: CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or CKAD.
* Terraform Associate certification is a strong differentiator.
* Security certification preferred: CompTIA Security\+, AZ\-500 (Azure Security Engineer) or equivalent.
* GCP Professional Cloud Architect or GCP Data Engineer preferred for the SimplifyX™ AI/Data track.



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  




* 4–8 years in cloud platform engineering, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure — with at least 2 years in a senior or lead individual contributor capacity on Azure.
* Hands\-on Azure expertise across: AKS, App Service, Azure SQL, APIM, Key Vault, Application Gateway, Service Bus, Azure Monitor, Defender for Cloud, Entra ID, Private Endpoints, and Container Apps.
* Proven Terraform experience: module design, workspace management, remote state, and pipeline integration.
* CI/CD pipeline design and ownership: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, multi\-environment promotion, deployment strategy implementation, and gating.
* Production Kubernetes operations: cluster management, Helm chart authoring, node pool design, autoscaling, and upgrade management.
* Experience in a SaaS or multi\-tenant cloud environment is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to healthcare compliance frameworks (HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST) is a significant advantage.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* Networking: VNet design, NSG rule management, Private Endpoints, DNS private zones, Application Gateway with WAF, Azure Firewall, and ExpressRoute/VPN awareness.

* Observability: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alert rule design, and dashboard creation. Datadog experience is a plus.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Technical Lead – Forward Deployed Engineering (Banking \& Financial Services)
 



**Company:** 
 SimplifyX™
 



**Industry:** 
 Health Technology \| Artificial Intelligence \| Enterprise Software
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India – On\-site / Hybrid

 14–20 years
 



  





**About SimplifyX™** 




 SimplifyX is an AI\-first product company building intelligent solutions for large health plans and banking and financial services enterprises across the US. Our Forward Deployed Engineering team works at the front line — embedded with clients, solving real\-world problems with production\-grade agentic AI.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Technical Lead – Forward Deployed Engineering to lead applied AI delivery for large banking and financial services enterprises across the US. This is a senior, client\-facing role at the intersection of enterprise AI engineering, BFS domain expertise, and technical leadership.
 



 As a Technical Lead FDE, you will own the end\-to\-end delivery of production agentic AI solutions — from initial discovery and solution design through to deployment and client handoff. You will work directly with client engineering, business, and operations teams, lead a high\-caliber engineering team, and engage with senior stakeholders to drive measurable business outcomes. You will also play a key role in shaping the FDE practice at SimplifyX as we scale.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of production\-grade agentic AI solutions for enterprise banking and financial services clients.
* Work directly with client teams — engineering, business, and operations — to understand real\-world problems and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Architect and deploy multi\-agent AI systems, RAG pipelines, LLM applications, and document intelligence solutions in production environments.
* Engage with CXO and senior client stakeholders to present solutions, communicate progress, and drive adoption.
* Lead and mentor a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, owning technical direction, code quality, and delivery timelines.
* Drive solution design decisions including agentic framework selection, retrieval architecture, evaluation strategy, and observability.
* Define and enforce enterprise standards around security, data confidentiality, access controls, and auditability across client deployments.
* Contribute to product development thinking — help shape internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and IP that can be leveraged across client engagements.
* Represent SimplifyX externally in client meetings, technical workshops, and solution presentations.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 12–18 years of overall experience with a strong track record in AI/ML engineering and client\-facing delivery.
* Degree from a premier institution (IIT or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying production multi\-agent AI systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, or MCP.
* Deep expertise in LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini) and RAG pipelines — including hybrid retrieval, re\-ranking, embeddings, vector databases, and evaluation frameworks.
* Strong Python engineering skills with experience writing production\-quality code in shared, large\-scale codebases.
* Proven experience working directly with enterprise clients — translating business problems into technical solutions and presenting outcomes to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams in fast\-paced, client\-delivery environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong domain knowledge in banking, financial services, fintech, insurance, capital markets, lending, or payments.
* Excellent communication skills — written and verbal — with the ability to engage confidently at the CXO level.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience co\-founding or contributing to a technology product from inception to delivery.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM fine\-tuning, evaluation pipelines, or observability tools such as LangSmith or RAGAS.
* Certifications in AI/ML or financial services (FRM, CFA, or equivalent).
* Experience with agentic protocols such as MCP or A2A.
* Familiarity with TypeScript or Go in addition to Python.
* Prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or AI Consulting role.



  





**Why SimplifyX™** 



* Lead real\-world AI deployments for large US\-based banking and financial services enterprises.
* Work at the cutting edge of agentic AI — multi\-agent systems, MCP, RAG, and LLM fine\-tuning in production.
* Own and shape the FDE practice at a rapidly scaling AI company.
* Work alongside deep domain experts and world\-class engineers.
* High\-visibility role with direct client engagement at senior levels.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach. It also mentors less\-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid\-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap


**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field


**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
 At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
   

  

**Opportunity to Innovate**
 The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
 This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
   

  

**A Place to Make Your Mark**
 We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
   

  

**Benefits That Work For You**
 Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
   

  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Team Lead, Field Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Field Engineer, Team Lead you will serve as a player\-coach — guiding a team of field engineers while personally executing the most complex, mission\-critical technical work yourself. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you are both the technical anchor for your team and Addepar's technical vanguard in the field, translating complex business requirements into production\-grade integrations, automations, and data solutions.
   

  

 You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite — from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white\-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI\-driven tooling. At the same time, you will develop your people\-management skills: providing daily guidance, coordinating work allocation, and turning the vision set by leadership into reality while keeping your team aligned to our core processes. This role combines a forward\-deployed delivery model with hands\-on technical depth and functional leadership of a high\-performing engineering team.
   

  

 Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

**Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i.e. 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST. (hybrid role)**
**What You’ll Do**
* Serve as a player\-coach: provide functional leadership and daily operational guidance to a team of field engineers while remaining a hands\-on technical contributor on the most complex engagements
* Architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
* Manage the team's work allocation and coordinate activities across simultaneous client engagements, ensuring results are delivered on schedule and in collaboration with cross\-functional partners
* Guide the team through issue resolution, proactively escalate blockers, and maintain alignment with client and internal stakeholders
* Design and implement production\-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time\-to\-value, and enable operational scale
* Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
* Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
* Write and review production\-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
* Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
* Support career development by providing continuous feedback loops on technical and project execution, mentoring engineers as they grow
* Identify and drive opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and automation for greater team efficiency, and develop internal frameworks and best practices that accelerate delivery
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence the platform roadmap

title: Data Architect — Snowflake & AWS (Presales + Delivery)
description:
**Data Architect — Snowflake \& AWS (Presales \+ Delivery)** 




 Level: Senior / Principal · Client\-facing · Anchor architect for the Snowflake–AWS stack
 



**About the Role** 




 We build data platforms, accelerators, and AI agents for enterprise clients — and every one of them stands on an architecture someone had to get right the first time. As Data Architect for our Snowflake \+ AWS stack, you will own that architecture across the engagement lifecycle: shaping the solution in presales, defending it in client workshops, and staying accountable for it through delivery.
 



 This is a dual\-hat role by design, roughly balanced between presales and delivery. In pursuit mode, you are the technical voice in RFP responses, discovery workshops, and proofs of concept — the person who turns a client’s problem statement into a credible, estimable, winnable solution. In delivery mode, you set the architecture, review what gets built against it, and make the judgment calls that keep platforms performant, governed, and within their Snowflake credit budget. Architects who design decks they never have to live with will not enjoy this role; architects who want their proposals held to account will.
 



**What You Will Do — Presales \& Solutioning** 



* Lead technical discovery with prospective clients: current\-state assessment, workload analysis, and translating business requirements into target\-state Snowflake \+ AWS architectures.
* Own the solution architecture in RFP/RFI responses and proposals: architecture diagrams, phased roadmaps, migration approaches, effort and team\-shape estimation, and the assumptions register that protects delivery later.
* Size and defend the commercial\-technical envelope: Snowflake credit and warehouse sizing, AWS consumption estimates, and TCO comparisons against incumbent or competing platforms — with rationale that survives procurement scrutiny.
* Design and lead proofs of concept and pilots that are scoped to prove the contested claim, not to demo the easy path.
* Present to audiences from data engineers to CIOs: whiteboard the architecture, take hostile questions, and communicate trade\-offs in business terms.
* Work the partner ecosystem: align with Snowflake and AWS field teams (SEs, partner managers) on joint pursuits, funding programs, and competency requirements.
* Feed the practice: convert pursuit patterns into reusable solution blueprints, estimation models, and accelerator requirements.



**What You Will Do — Architecture \& Delivery** 



* Define end\-to\-end data architectures on Snowflake and AWS: ingestion (Snowpipe, streams and tasks, Kafka/Kinesis, DMS, Glue), storage and modeling layers, transformation (dbt, Snowpark), and consumption (BI, data sharing, APIs, AI/agent workloads).
* Set the data modeling standards for engagements: dimensional and lakehouse patterns, medallion layering, and when each is overkill.
* Design the governance and security model: RBAC hierarchies, masking and row\-access policies, tagging, data classification, and audit posture — aligned to client regulatory contexts.
* Own performance and cost discipline: warehouse right\-sizing, query optimization, clustering and materialization decisions, resource monitors, and credit\-burn reviews as a standing practice, not a rescue mission.
* Architect migrations to Snowflake from legacy warehouses (Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server, Hadoop) and between clouds, including cutover and reconciliation strategy.
* Design for interoperability: external tables and Iceberg, cross\-cloud data sharing, and integration with the AWS\-native estate (S3, Glue Catalog, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, IAM).
* Prepare data foundations for AI consumption: semantic layers, documentation and metadata that agents can reason over, and patterns for exposing governed Snowflake data to LLM and agent workloads.
* Review delivery against the architecture: design authority for engineering teams, unblocking the hardest technical decisions, and keeping as\-built honest to as\-sold.



**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* 12\+ years in data engineering and architecture, with 4\+ years architecting production Snowflake platforms at enterprise scale — including at least one greenfield build and one migration.
* Deep, hands\-on Snowflake expertise: performance tuning, cost governance, security and RBAC design, data sharing, Snowpark, and the trade\-offs behind each — depth we will test technically, not by certification.
* Strong AWS proficiency across the data estate: S3, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis/MSK, DMS, Step Functions, IAM, and network/security patterns (PrivateLink, VPC design) for enterprise Snowflake deployments.
* Demonstrated presales experience: solutions you architected in winning bids, PoCs you led, and estimates you produced that delivery teams subsequently lived with. We will ask for specifics — deal shapes, your role, and what you got wrong.
* Expert SQL and working Python; fluency with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework.
* Mastery of data modeling: dimensional, data vault or lakehouse patterns, and the judgment to choose between them per workload.
* Executive\-grade communication: you can hold the room in a CIO briefing and a deep\-dive with the client’s DBAs on the same day.



**Good to Have** 



* SnowPro Advanced Architect and/or AWS Solutions Architect Professional certification.
* Experience with Snowflake’s AI capabilities (Cortex, document AI) or exposing warehouse data to LLM/agent workloads (text\-to\-SQL, semantic models).
* Apache Iceberg and open table format strategy experience.
* Data catalog, lineage, and observability tooling (e.g., Atlan, Collibra, Alation, Monte Carlo).
* Streaming architecture depth (Kafka/Kinesis at scale, CDC patterns).
* Consulting background with multi\-client delivery; supply chain, manufacturing, or ERP (SAP/Oracle) data domain exposure.
* Contributions to reusable IP: solution blueprints, estimation frameworks, migration toolkits, or published technical content.

**Title And Summary**
 Senior Platform Architect

 Infrastructure Design Services is a team of Technology Architects and Engineers responsible for the analysis and design of the infrastructure framework to fit the application, platform or system needs in\-line with MasterCard's operational standards and principles.

* Generating requirements, together with other architects, engineers, development team(s) and user(s), to determine that all the high\-level requirements have been met.

* Research and evaluate new technology for possible deployment in MasterCard’s infrastructure.

 Perform problem diagnosis; performance tuning; capacity planning and configuration management for MasterCard internet components

* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team
* Must be high\-energy, proactive, detail\-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self\-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:

**Principal, Terraform Engineering
   

  

 Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly experienced engineering leader with
 **15\+ years of expertise** 
 in infrastructure automation and cloud engineering. As the Principal Terraform Engineering Lead, you will drive the
 **innovative adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**

* Standardization \& Governance: Establish enterprise\-wide standards, guardrails, and reusable modules to accelerate adoption and reduce risk.
* Hands\-on Engineering: Provide technical leadership and hands\-on expertise in Terraform, cloud automation, and infrastructure modernization.
* Collaboration \& Influence: Partner with product engineering, risk governance, and infrastructure teams to drive adoption and innovation.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Strong architectural background in multi\-cloud (Azure, AWS) and private cloud platforms.
* Experience driving enterprise\-wide adoption of IaC frameworks in regulated industries.
* Proven ability to embed resiliency, observability, and compliance into infrastructure delivery pipelines.
* Strong leadership edge with experience as a global service owner or platform lead.

**Preferred Background**

* Familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks (ISO, NIST, DORA, PRA, CSA CCM).
* Expertise in cloud modernization, automation frameworks, and operational resilience.


**Leadership Attributes**
* Visionary leader with the ability to transform infrastructure delivery at scale.
* Collaborative and influential communicator across global teams and executive stakeholders.
* Recognized as a trusted advisor and problem solver in infrastructure modernization.
* Passionate about driving innovation, standardization, and resilience in technology delivery.


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

description:

description:
